title: zanthoxylum duckei
intro: Zanthoxylum duckei, commonly known as the "Black Pepper Tree" or "Pepper Tree", is a species of plant in the Rutaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve pain, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Zanthoxylum duckei include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include limonoids, coumarins, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its various therapeutic effects.
